name: eq_or_mem_iff_mem
statement: WSeq α} {a a' s'} : some (a', s') ∈ destruct s → (a ∈ s ↔ a = a' ∨ a ∈ s')

name: mem_of_mem_dropn
statement: WSeq α} {a} : ∀ {n}, a ∈ drop s n → a ∈ s | 0, h => h | n + 1, h => @mem_of_mem_dropn s a n (mem_of_mem_tail h)  theorem get?_mem {s : WSeq α} {a n} : some a ∈ get? s n → a ∈ s

name: exists_dropn_of_mem
statement: WSeq α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) : ∃ n s', some (a, s') ∈ destruct (drop s n)
